subject: general
question:
You are given two statements :

(1) Some notebooks are laptops.

(2) All laptops are wallets. 

Which of the following conclusions is/are true?

A. Some wallets are notebooks. 

B. Some laptops are wallets.
solution:
**Given statements: **

(1) Some notebooks are laptops.

(2) All laptops are wallets.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54244238b81a5e4fa8e457a9d673ceb2025d393c927a5011fd9715f165125c9a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d559d718bd3bf5b6e55b7a589cae8dcacd6f9d6d0b83e54745fcdad7dcac1fc9.png] 

**Conclusion:**

A. Some wallets are notebooks. - **True** (Because, Some notebooks are laptops and All laptops are wallets. So, Some wallets are also notebooks)

B. Some laptops are wallets. - True (Because, All laptops are wallets. So, Some laptops are also wallets)

So, Both A and B are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both A and B".**
